attributes.constraints: READS the objects already on disk and never builds one, so its answer is as fresh as your last ninja for the TU — run a build first if you have edited since. It answers the ASSIGNMENT question only; the frame/slot side is slotdiff.py's, which probe already auto-invokes on a save-set delta. Rows pair by REGISTER NUMBER and compare the defining instruction's ROLE (the `addi rD,rS,0` and `mr rD,rS` spellings of a copy are folded together); EMISSION ORDER is reported separately and is a SCHEDULE fact, not an assignment one. Pairing by order instead was measured wrong on the function the governing law came from.
